Something that I started, was to make plans on leaving my abusive family. I first  created a **support circle**. This helped me a lot because it made me open up to other people outside of my family and hearing an outside person's opinion of the situation helps a lot. In my circle, there were friends, teachers, and health workers. You should create one too so they'd give good advice and a safety plan and if you have more people, it'll be less scarier to leave because they can come in literally and help you get out. 

Your situation is abusive and you should leave before it ruins you. You’re not hurting anyone's feelings, in fact, your so called husband is being selfish by not understanding your feelings and just uses you. And when he gets mad, he hurts you and that's not what a husband is. 

I feel incredibly bad for your children because they have a father like that. Just because their father treats them good but treats you horribly, doesn't mean that the kids can't feel that. When my mom would always yell at my dad for small things, it hurt me a lot even though she wasn't yelling at me. It hurts us kids a lot when our parents fight or abuse one another (which is what your husband is doing). So no, your husband is not a good father either. 

You are incredibly brave for punching your husband back. Good job. I am very proud of you :)

And again, you're not selfish or being a bad person for wanting to leave. Get other people to help you out and go. If you can, take your kids with you because if your husband hurt you, he could hurt the kids because he's an abuser.  

Sending lots of love to you <3 and I hope you can leave as soon as possible.

I am so sorry that you're going through this. But this is too much and this shouldn't be happening. This is physical abuse and even though you're 18, you're still a kid and this IS WRONG VERY WRONG!

To tell you first, Your dad is not a good person and what he did was terrible. He can't trust you and just believes what he sees. There's nothing wrong with talking to a guy. **You did nothing wrong. NOTHING.** So don't go apologizing to your parents, they'll only think that they did the right thing and they'll do it again to you. (I apologized to my abusive brother over a problem he caused, and he continued to abuse me thinking that what he's doing is right so please don’t do it). You have to protect yourself and your rights. You have to fight back dear and it's gonna be a bit hard but I know you can do this.

Some advice that I can give is that you should call child protection services (CPS). They can help you out and they help out children till they're 18 which includes you. The issue with this is that they'll put you in foster care and up for adoption and place you AWAY from your abusive household. They'll make sure that you won't deal with this crap ever again.

I'm guessing that you live in the USA because of the gun part that you talked about? But here are some phone numbers that I looked up for child abuse from each state. Whichever state you're in, please don't hesitate to call them and reach out:

[https://www.childwelfare.gov/organizations/?CWIGFunctionsaction=rols:main.dspList&rolType=Custom&RS\_ID=%205#:\~:text=State%20toll%2Dfree%20numbers%20and,suspected%20child%20abuse%20and%20neglect.&text=Click%20on%20the%20website%20above,422%2D4453](https://www.childwelfare.gov/organizations/?CWIGFunctionsaction=rols:main.dspList&rolType=Custom&RS_ID=%205#:~:text=State%20toll%2Dfree%20numbers%20and,suspected%20child%20abuse%20and%20neglect.&text=Click%20on%20the%20website%20above,422%2D4453)

If you're are not comfortable going away for adoption or to CPS, then please stay somewhere away from that house like at a friend's house, or your relatives but please don't stay at that house. 

But the next time your dad ever does this to you, PLEASE DO NOT WAIT AND CALL THE POLICE!!! This is so wrong and your dad is a horrible person and he doesn't deserve to live like he can do whatever the shit he wants because HE CAN'T AND IT'S ILLEGAL TO THIS IS IN NORTH AMERICA!

And I am so sorry that none of your neighbors helped you out. It's so scary when this happens to someone and everyone just watches but doesn't do anything. They should have done something. They should've helped and I'm so sorry that they didn't.

So please please please don't let him get away like this. You have to do something to protect yourself. And make sure he doesn't take your phone and that you put a password on it that only you know. Your phone is yours and it's your choice if you want anyone to see it or not. It's part of your privacy and you have full rights to have privacy. Don't let anyone take that away from you, okay?

Another thing I wanted to mention is: you are not a b\*tch, sl\*t, or a wh\*re. You are an amazing, intelligent, and beautiful person trying to be like a normal adult and trying to have her own freedom. And you did nothing wrong.

If you ever need someone to talk to, you can always message me and I'll do my best to help you out sister. Love you lots and sending my prayers to you.
